name: t5-buyer
prompt: Exactly as in the image: in a busy wholesale warehouse among sacks of grain and labelled cartons, a man in his late thirties in a grey shirt sits holding a phone, its back to the camera, on a call on speaker. He reads, grins, and says into the phone, in an Indian English accent: "Fourteen-twenty a pack? Done. Send the truck." His face and lips move naturally with his words. The camera holds still with a very slow push in. Audio: his voice clear and close, the low murmur of the warehouse, no music.
negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, on-screen text, music, singing, children, deformed hands, extra fingers, morphing face, distorted mouth, flicker
shipped: the Veo output re-encoded for the repository (H.264 crf 20, AAC 160k); the original stays in src/clips/talk/
